description.en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among all requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not set this parameter, ClientToken is set to the value of RequestId. The value of RequestId for each API request may be different.

description.zh:
流日志的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The description of the flow log.

The description is optional. If you enter a description, it must be 1 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://.
The ID of the flow log.

description.zh:
流日志的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The name of the flow log.

The name is optional. If you enter a name, it must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://.

description.zh:
流日志的版本。

创建流日志时自动使用系统支持的最新版本，当前为**3**。
description.en:
The flow log version.

Flow logs are automatically created in the latest version, which is **3**.

description.zh: 流日志捕获流量的捕获窗口时长。单位：秒。取值：**60**或**600**。默认值：**600**。
description.en: The time window for collecting log data. Unit: seconds Valid values: **60** or **600** Default value: **600**.

description.zh:
存储捕获流量的LogStore名称。

Logstore名称长度为3~63字符，必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾，只能包括小写字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
description.en:
The name of the Logstore where the flow log is stored.

The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start or end with a lowercase letter or a digit.
The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最小值：**1**。默认值：**20**。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: **1**. Default value: **20**.

description.zh:
存储捕获流量的Project名称。

Project名称长度为3~63字符，必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾，只能包括小写字母、数字和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the project where the flow log is stored.

The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start or end with a lowercase letter or a digit.

description.zh:
流日志所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the flow log is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
流日志的状态。取值：

- **Active**：已启动。

- **Inactive**：未启动。
description.en:
The status of the flow log. Valid values:

*   **Active**: The flow log is enabled.
*   **Inactive**: The flow log is disabled.

description.zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息。
description.en:
The information about the tags.

You can specify at most 20 tags in each call.
The ID of the network instance connection.
The ID of the transit router.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn describe-flowlogs --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --flow-log-name myFlowlog --flow-log-id flowlog-m5evbtbpt0000 --description myFlowlog --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000 --project-name FlowLogProject --log-store-name FlowLogStore --status Active --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --tag Value=TagValue Key=TagKey --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-qieks13jnt1cchy000 --transit-router-id tr-uf654ttymmljlvh2x0000 --interval 600 --flow-log-version 3 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn DescribeFlowlogs --region cn-hangzhou --Status Active --TransitRouterAttachmentId 'tr-attach-qieks13jnt1cchy000' --FlowLogVersion 3 --Tag.1.Key TagKey --Description myFlowlog --PageSize 20 --ProjectName FlowLogProject --FlowLogId 'flowlog-m5evbtbpt0000' --FlowLogName myFlowlog --LogStoreName FlowLogStore --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TagValue --CenId 'cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --TransitRouterId 'tr-uf654ttymmljlvh2x0000' --Interval 600
